answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with non-parallelizable interactive proving tied to infrastructure diversity. At an unpredictable moment, each identity must complete a reasoning task that cannot run in parallel across clones, and prove distinct infrastructure: a separate network origin, hardware enclave, and funding source. Like a tide exposing a dune only briefly, the window is short; a yarrow in one place cannot bloom everywhere at once. A farmer of thousands of fakes must buy thousands of real machines and pass thousands of simultaneous tests, costing more than the harvest.
